title: Positions of Large Groups
summary: Given a string s of lowercase letters, where the letters form consecutive groups of the same character, identify and return the intervals of all groups that are at least three characters long, sorted in increasing order by their starting index.
statement: Given a string s of lowercase letters, where the letters form consecutive groups of the same character, identify and return the intervals of all groups that are at least three characters long, sorted in increasing order by their starting index.
constraints: Return [start,end] for every maximal run of at least three equal characters.
hints: A maximal run ends when the next character differs or the string ends.
Track its start and emit boundaries when its length reaches three.
At each boundary, if end-start>=3 append [start,end-1], then reset start.
Every maximal run is inspected exactly once and inclusive indices follow directly from the exclusive scan endpoint.
editorial: Every maximal run is inspected exactly once and inclusive indices follow directly from the exclusive scan endpoint.
